deviations: The decoding's mark is the existing 'decoding' mark of TryReadXRefStream rather than a second one. For a candidate it is taken as a decodings-report mark ('deferred is null && !candidate ? GetMark() : GetMarkWithDecodingReports()') and recorded on the new internal XRefSectionRecord.UndecodedReports, for candidates only. Every 'continue' of the decode loop already rolls back to that mark, so at an undecoded return only the decoding's reports and guards lie past it. The outer mark at the old :4967 is removed. Copies of the decoding-report dictionary are now taken only for places that reach the decode, not for every place tried.
